answer: A farm running 139 keys therefore forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. Because the voyage stake is held until the haven settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the pearl audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 34% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
